title: Logo/Design Specification (spec.json) - Structured Verbal Description
description: Complete verbalizable description of a design (logo, sculpture, vehicle) sufficient for unfamiliar person to draw it. Segments capture subsections with inferred 3D volumes and candidate LEGO parts. Generated by Agent A1 (Descriptor GT) once per design; reused across all improvement loop iterations.

canonical_description.description: Rich prose description (200+ words) from which an unfamiliar person could produce a detailed drawing.
